messages.subject: Installation Issues
parts:
Hello,

My apologies if this has been answered before. I found some similar threads but could not resolve my issues. When I attempt to load in the poppr package, I receive the following error:



library("poppr")
Loading required package: adegenet
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘adegenet’ in loadNamespace(j <- i[[1L]], c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[j]]):
 there is no package called ‘shiny’
Error: package ‘adegenet’ could not be loaded




I can not seem to get around this. If I attempt to instal 'shiny' I receive the following error:
 
Warning in install.packages :
  installation of package ‘shiny’ had non-zero exit status


Any advice would be greatly appreciated.

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Installation Issues
parts:
Hello,

I'm afraid I cannot diagnose this error. There are several reasons why this may be happening. One of the most common problems is if you are loading a previous session and attempt to update a package that is loaded. To prevent that, try following the instructions here to set up your RStudio and R session to avoid reloading your previous working session: https://r4epis.netlify.app/welcome/#configuring-rstudio

Best,

Zhian
